title: Predicating
description: The transfinite homotopy generator over a potential-aperiodic-articulation-cell. Predicating generates the transfinite-predication-category as its codomain object. Given a potential-aperiodic-articulation-cell whose carrier is the utterance pair [token, claim], predicating opens the transfinite-predication-category whose predication-cell-set is Phi = E x Pi x E around that token-schema and claim-schema position. It does not extract subject/predicate/object labels from claim.const; resolved substrate coordinates belong to later projections. Settlement-cell-trace-points are later finite presentations inside settling; they are not this generator's codomain.

input.description: Predicating's input: the potential-aperiodic-articulation-cell whose carrier is the utterance's token/claim pair.

output.description: Predicating's codomain object: the transfinite-predication-category generated from the potential-aperiodic-articulation-cell.
